milestones.name: Synthetic ticket generator
milestones.done_criteria: 18 months of seeded hourly arrivals with weekday/hour seasonality, holidays and incident surges; resolution times driven by category, priority and queue load

milestones.name: Forecast backtest
milestones.done_criteria: Rolling-origin backtest (6 x 28 days) with MAE/MAPE for seasonal naive vs calendar-feature ridge; 28-day forecast with residual-quantile intervals

milestones.name: SLA breach model
milestones.done_criteria: Gradient boosting on creation-time features plus queue length; time-based split; ROC AUC, precision@top10% and permutation importance reported

milestones.name: Staffing model
milestones.done_criteria: Erlang C agents per hour for 80/20 with occupancy cap; typical-week heatmap from the forecast

milestones.name: Interval calibration and drift monitoring
milestones.done_criteria: Horizon-aware interval calibration and an automated drift check that flags when live MAPE exceeds the backtest by 30%

milestones.name: ServiceNow / Jira export connector
milestones.done_criteria: Read-only export adapter that maps ServiceNow incident and Jira Service Management fields onto the deskcast ticket schema, with timestamp validation

milestones.name: Power BI dashboard
milestones.done_criteria: Star-schema CSV export and a Power BI report with forecast, SLA risk and staffing pages

next_actions.title: Define ServiceNow incident-table field mapping onto the deskcast schema
Drift check that compares rolling MAPE with the backtest and flags a 30% gap
Timestamp data-quality checks for exports (time zones, resolved before created, bulk closures)

risks.risk: Concept drift: ticket mix and volumes shift after re-orgs, tooling migrations or self-service launches, so models fitted on history degrade
risks.mitigation: Re-run the rolling-origin backtest weekly in CI; add the drift check (B-09) that flags when live MAPE exceeds the backtest by 30%

risks.risk: Data quality of timestamps: time-zone mismatches, resolved-before-created rows and bulk-closure scripts in real ITSM exports
risks.mitigation: Validation checks in the pipeline today; export-side checks with the connector (B-11)

risks.risk: Incident surges: major outages create unforecastable spikes that inflate error and SLA breaches
risks.mitigation: Report incident days separately; prediction intervals from backtest residuals; use the ITSM major-incident flag once connected

risks.risk: Synthetic-to-real gap: generator parameters may not match a real service desk
risks.mitigation: Keep every claim scoped to synthetic data; re-fit and re-validate on real exports via the connector milestone (M6)

risks.risk: SLA label leakage: a feature that is only known after creation inflates AUC
risks.mitigation: Feature list restricted to creation-time fields and queue state; time-based train/test split; unit test guards the feature list

risks.risk: Holiday effects: regional holidays, bridge days and the year-end freeze are misforecast
risks.mitigation: Holiday, day-after-holiday and year-end features; holiday-masked lags; region-specific calendar (B-13)

risks.risk: Erlang C assumptions: Poisson arrivals, no abandonment and one queue overstate staffing for asynchronous portal and email work
risks.mitigation: Document the assumption; split staffing by channel and evaluate Erlang A before using the numbers for rosters

data_says: Forecast: the calendar-feature ridge model beats seasonal naive by 53% on MAPE (15.0% vs 32.1%) and 23% on MAE across 6 rolling 28-day folds.
Demand: 2,688 tickets expected 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-28 (80% band 2,130 to 3,306); busiest day 2026-07-06 at about 154.
SLA risk: ROC AUC 0.838; the top 10% riskiest tickets breach 54% of the time vs a 15% base rate (3.5x). Top driver: day of week.
Staffing: peak of 8 agents (Mon 11:00) and 469 agent-hours in a typical week for 80%/20s, about 16.8 FTE after 30% shrinkage.
Data: 56,423 synthetic tickets over 546 days, 16.7% SLA breach rate, 5 injected incident surges, 0 timestamp-order violations.
